column8: ["Give the broad amber face more crafted detail: glaze pooling, fine crazing and rubbed edges would make its mottling feel like fired ceramic.","Differentiate the reddish socket collars with dark brass recesses, polished contact edges and restrained rubber lips; their materials currently blend together.","Resolve the central dark ring into a convincing fitted mechanism with a crisp inner lip and purposeful wear; it currently reads as a muddy scorch.","Strengthen the perimeter's thickness with a more decisive lower edge and localized contact shadow so the housing feels heavier on the clay."]
